# MoleculeDesk

> MoleculeDesk is an open-source package manager and runtime for running molecular AI models locally. It is in early development; check each model page for current support.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://moleculedesk.com/docs): installation, CLI workflow, model status, and architecture.
- [Installation](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/installation): one-command install for macOS and Linux (no Node.js or npm needed), then check your system.
- [Model compatibility](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/model-compatibility): supported platforms and status definitions.
- [Agent skills](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/agent-skills): install the MoleculeDesk skill in Claude Code (`claude plugin install moldesk --marketplace pooriyapfn/moldesk`) or Codex (`codex plugin marketplace add pooriyapfn/moldesk`, then `/plugins`). Skill source: https://github.com/pooriyapfn/moldesk/tree/main/plugins/moldesk/skills/moldesk

## Practical guides

- [Run Boltz-2 locally](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/guides/run-boltz-locally): requirements, commands, input, and output.
- [Molecular AI on Apple Silicon](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/guides/apple-silicon): verified and unverified paths.
- [Design a PD-L1 binder with RFD4-Proteina on a cloud GPU](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/guides/design-pd-l1-binder-rfd4-proteina): 8 binder designs in about 5 minutes for roughly $0.09 on a rented L40S, with measured time, cost, per-design results and a 3D viewer.
- [RFD4-Proteina model page](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/models/rfd4-proteina): condition specs, parameters, Runpod benchmarks and verification status.
- [Boltz-2 model page](https://moleculedesk.com/docs/models/boltz): model details and platform support.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pooriyapfn/moldesk): source code, examples, and issue tracker.
